en: Home on the Range
Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
Gettin' Buzzed
Gather $1oa Wild Honey from Wasp Nests using Berdun's Pellet Gun.

What's a travel lodge without somethin' to drink?

I can brew a fine mead, but I'm gettin' a bit on in years to gather the honey myself. There are wasp nests in the trees north of the Haldaar camp, an' west of Valormok. If ye see hippogryphs, yer in the right place.

They're nasty buggers, but the honey is like nothin' ye've ever tasted. I'll lend ye my pellet gun to knock down the hives, ye can't reach 'em otherwise.
Deadliest Catch
Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
Murloc Thieves
Take the Memory Crystal from Razorgill near the Tower of Eldara, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

On the beaches of the northern peninsula, east of here, I came upon the Tower of Eldara. While surveying the site, I noticed a large orange murloc wielding a spiked club, and carrying a peculiar glowing crystal. Given the location, it was likely the kind that the highborne used to store their history and memories.

We must recover that crystal, $r. Who knows what secrets it could contain?

The best route to the tower is along the cliffs, with the nearest way up being just west of here.
A Monumental Task
Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
Your Final Reward
See what Saria has to show you.

I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, $n, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology.

Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear.

To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me?
Winter Frontier Fishery
Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point, in Azshara.

Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Squid are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.
Pin Cushion
Fetch arrows in the archery range south of the New Avalon town square. You may also acquire arrows when fighting rangers.

Whoa! Awfully brave to be stomping around the shooting grounds amidst our training. You're practically begging for a projectile to the knee, or maybe your behind given the way you're shuffling around.

But hey, your safety is your prerogative. Since you seem like a real risk taker, why not lend us a helping hand? Gathering our arrows after every round of shots takes away from precious shooting time.

How about you go grab a few for me, eh?
Nondisclosure Arguement

Fizzlefuse in New Avalon has requested a quill and something to make his hideout more comfortable. A Classy Quill can be found in the New Avalon Town Hall, and a House Prop may be found somewhere near Scholomance or in the Karazhan Crypts.

I am not the type of goblin to share his secrets with some random adventurer, but I AM the type to share a gnome's! I happened to procure a few schematics on my way out here and am working on correcting the shortcomings in their designs. They still use safety fuses! Can you believe that? SAFETY FUSES!!

Anyway, I am eager to share my progress, but I need a quill if I am going to scribble out all this junk. And I could use a cozy space so I can do some thinking. What do you say?
Ill Tidings
Bring Saria's Knapsack back to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.
<With Saria's true intentions revealed, and a bag of powerful artifacts in hand, perhaps now would be a good time give Commander Truesong her report.>
